national_news.title: PM Modi Calls for Concrete Goals to Strengthen Quad Partnership in Indo-Pacific
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the Quad meeting in Manila, describing it as a trusted partnership aimed at delivering practical solutions for the Indo-Pacific.
Noted historical milestones: officials first met in Manila in 2007, and the city hosted the revival of the Quad dialogue in 2017.
Highlighted cooperation across maritime security, trusted supply chains, emerging technologies, and disaster response, noting foreign ministers have met five times since January of the previous year.

national_news.title: 23rd ASEAN-India Summit Held in Manila to Strengthen Regional Ties
bullets: PM Modi addressed the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit in Manila under the theme 'Navigating Our Future Together', marking his 13th interaction with ASEAN leaders.
Highlighted the convergence of the ASEAN Community Vision 2045 and India's vision of Viksit Bharat by 2047.
Noted achievements since 2014 including over 100 initiatives, 250 quick-impact projects, and more than 10,000 skill development scholarships.

national_news.title: ASEAN and India Adopt Joint Statement on Disaster Management Cooperation
bullets: Adopted the ASEAN-India Joint Statement on Cooperation in Disaster Management at the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit in Manila.
Agreed to strengthen coordination among agencies like the ACDM, AHA Centre, and India's National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA).
Focused on early warning systems, satellite data exchange, artificial intelligence in disaster risk assessment, and implementation under the ASEAN-India Plan of Action (2026-2030).

national_news.title: India’s Electronics Exports Surge 44% to USD 32 Billion in H1 FY
bullets: India's electronic goods exports grew 44 per cent to USD 32 billion during April-September, up from USD 22 billion in the previous period.
Smartphone exports rose over 35 per cent to USD 18 billion, accounting for 56.8 per cent of total electronic exports.
Non-smartphone electronics grew over 56 per cent to USD 13 billion, with mounted printed circuit boards showing a massive surge; Singapore and China emerged as leading destinations.

national_news.title: Logo and Mascot Unveiled for 8th Khelo India Youth Games
bullets: Union Youth Affairs and Sports Minister Dr Mansukh Mandaviya and Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy unveiled the logo and mascot for the 8th Khelo India Youth Games.
The Games will be held across six cities in Telangana from 11th to 22nd December.
Around 8,000 athletes are expected to participate across 29 disciplines, including 27 competitive sports and two demonstration events.

national_news.title: India's Higher Education Sector Expands Significantly Over 12 Years
bullets: Vice-President CP Radhakrishnan stated that universities in India increased from 760 in 2014-15 to over 1,400 at present.
Number of IITs increased from 16 to 23, IIMs from 13 to 22, and AIIMS from 7 to 20 over the 12-year period.
Higher education student enrollment rose from 3.42 crore to over 4.5 crore.

national_news.title: Overview of India's Administrative and Public Health Response to COVID-19
bullets: India's pandemic response period extended from January 2020 to May 2023, combining central direction with state implementation.
As of 31 December 2025, 97 per cent of the population aged 12 and above received at least one vaccine dose, and 90 per cent were fully vaccinated, with 22.89 crore precaution doses administered.
Emergency powers under the Disaster Management Act, 2005 were delegated to the Union Health Secretary on March 11, 2020, and 11 Empowered Groups were constituted on March 29, 2020.

national_news.title: Implementation and Significance of the Forest Rights Act, 2006
bullets: The Forest Rights Act (FRA), 2006, came into force on December 31, 2007, providing legal recognition to land and community forest rights of Scheduled Tribes and traditional forest dwellers.

Eligible Other Traditional Forest Dwellers (OTFDs) must have resided in and depended on forests for at least three generations (75 years) prior to December 13, 2005, with individual land claims capped at a maximum of four hectares.
The Ministry of Tribal Affairs is the nodal ministry for implementation, with over 25.42 lakh titles distributed across approximately 238 lakh acres in 20 states and Jammu & Kashmir.

national_news.title: National Naturopathy Day and Drug-Free Healthcare Initiatives
bullets: India observes National Naturopathy Day on November 18, with the 9th edition hosted at Nagamangala, Karnataka, under the theme 'Prakrutik Chikitsa, Swasth Bharat'.
Naturopathy is a drug-free, cost-effective system utilizing diet, fasting, water, mud, and massage to promote self-healing.
The National Institute of Naturopathy, Pune, operates Nisarg Gram, featuring a 250-bedded hospital and the first Central Government-run Bachelor of Naturopathy and Yogic Sciences (BNYS) college.

national_news.title: Functional Integration of PIB and Central Bureau of Communication
bullets: The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting ordered the integration of the Central Bureau of Communication (CBC), formerly DAVP, into the Press Information Bureau (PIB) on November 12, 2026.
The unified organization will operate under the heading of the Director General (Coordination), PIB, New Delhi.
The administrative integration process will be systematically replicated at state branch levels in a phased manner.

national_news.title: Vice-President Highlights 12-Year Expansion Milestones in Higher Education
bullets: Vice-President CP Radhakrishnan announced that India's higher education enrolment expanded from 3.42 crore to over 4.5 crore students over the past twelve years.
Key institutional expansions since 2014-15 include universities increasing from 760 to over 1,400, IITs from 16 to 23, IIMs from 13 to 22, and AIIMS institutes from 7 to 20.
The VP also inaugurated the orientation program for the 17th Odisha Legislative Assembly, stressing informed debate and parliamentary procedures.

national_news.title: PM Narendra Modi Participates in 23rd India-ASEAN and 21st East Asia Summits in Manila
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi arrived in Manila, Philippines, to attend the 23rd India-ASEAN Summit and the 21st East Asia Summit.

During the visit, PM Modi viewed the Laguna Copperplate Inscription (dating back to 900 CE, written in Kawi script), the earliest dated document discovered in the Philippines highlighting historical Indo-Philippine ties.
The engagements strengthen India's Act East Policy and bilateral ties with ASEAN member nations.

national_news.title: Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas Celebrated Nationwide to Honor Bhagwan Birsa Munda
bullets: Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas was observed across India to mark the birth anniversary of tribal freedom fighter Bhagwan Birsa Munda (Dharti Aaba).
In Jharkhand, new Eklavya Model Residential Schools were inaugurated in Gumla and foundation stones laid in Ranchi, alongside tribute ceremonies in Khunti.
In Madhya Pradesh, the Rs 1,353-crore Dahi Micro Irrigation Lift Project was dedicated to the public in Dhar district, while Manipur inaugurated its State-Level Tribal Cultural Festival in Imphal.

national_news.title: Press Council of India Celebrates National Press Day in New Delhi
bullets: Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw addressed the National Press Day celebrations organized by the Press Council of India (PCI) at Akashvani Bhawan, New Delhi.
The official theme for this year's event was 'Journalism: Populist or Responsible', highlighting key media challenges including AI deepfakes, misinformation, and digital arrests.
PCI Chairperson Justice (Retd.) Ranjana Prakash Desai and I&B Secretary Chanchal Kumar stressed upholding journalistic ethics, fact-checking, and accountability over digital virality.
national_news.exam_tag: National Press Day / Press Council of India

national_news.title: Indian Railways Approves Cross-Border Train Service Connecting Janakpur and Ayodhya
bullets: Indian Railways approved a new weekly train service covering a 604 km route to directly connect Janakpur Dham in Nepal with Ayodhya Cantt in Uttar Pradesh.
The train will run through key towns in Bihar and UP, including Jaynagar, Madhubani, Sitamarhi, Raxaul, Narkatiaganj, and Gorakhpur, linking major sites of the Ramayana Circuit.
The project builds on the 69 km Jayanagar-Janakpur-Bardibas railway project executed by IRCON with Indian financial aid of around ₹1,000 crore ($120 million) to boost cross-border connectivity.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Launches 'Ganna Vikas Rath-2026' to Promote Sugarcane Cultivation
bullets: Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary launched the 'Ganna Vikas Rath-2026' from the Secretariat in Patna, organized by the Sugarcane Industries Department.
The state currently has 10 operational sugar mills, with 5 more set to begin operations soon to revive the rural economy and boost farmers' income.
The initiative aims to educate farmers on modern agricultural techniques, sugarcane mechanization subsidies, and digital tools like the 'Ganna ID' and 'Ganna Sathi' AI chatbot.

bihar_news.title: Prime Minister to Inaugurate 19.76-km Kachchi Dargah-Bidupur Six-Lane Bridge 'Nitish Setu' in Bihar
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to inaugurate the 19.76-km six-lane bridge named 'Nitish Setu' over the Ganga on November 21, 2026.
The bridge connects Kachchi Dargah in Patna district to Bidupur in Vaishali district via Raghopur Diara, implemented by BSRDCL with construction by L&T and Daewoo.
The project's total approved cost is Rs 4,988.40 crore, featuring financial assistance of USD 450.84 million from the Asian Development Bank (ADB).

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Proposes Two New Sugar Mills in Motipur and Saran
bullets: The Bihar government has proposed setting up two new sugar mills at Motipur (Muzaffarpur) and Taraiya (Saran).
Detailed Project Reports (DPRs) have been initiated to assess technical and financial feasibility.
The initiative aims to support sugarcane farmers, reduce transportation costs, generate employment, and revive Bihar's sugar industry.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Launches 'Sankalp Sandhya' Programme for Free Evening Classes
bullets: The Bihar Education Department launched 'Sankalp Sandhya' to provide free evening classes for academically weak students in Classes 9 to 12.
Classes will run daily from 5 pm to 7:30 pm across selected government schools in all 38 district headquarters until March 31, 2027.
The curriculum covers five subjects: English, Mathematics, Science, Computer Science, and Artificial Intelligence (AI).

bihar_news.title: Pathways Plus Initiative Bridges Digital Divide in Bihar
bullets: Sumair Kandhari's digital education initiative 'Pathways Plus', launched in 2023, has reached over 1,700 students and 750 women in Bihar.
The program was developed in partnership with KCS Foundation India and features a computer laboratory established in Samastipur with 20 workstations.
Pathways Plus provides structured training in computer skills, Python programming, and artificial intelligence (AI) to underserved rural students.

bihar_news.title: Northeast Frontier Railway Achieves 100% Electrification Across Jurisdiction
bullets: The Northeast Frontier Railway (NFR) announced 100% railway electrification across its jurisdiction in North-East India within a decade, totaling 4,311.96 route kilometres (RKM).

The electrification initiative began in 2017-18 to modernize infrastructure and promote greener transportation, with Assam accounting for the largest share at 2,546.04 RKM and Bihar contributing 427.49 RKM.
Recent milestones include the completion of electrification in the Lumding-Badarpur section on September 14, 2026, and the Bairabi-Sairang section in Mizoram on October 12, 2026.

bihar_news.title: RailTel Secures Major Orders for Smart Classrooms and ICT Labs in Bihar
bullets: RailTel Corporation of India secured a major work order worth Rs 57.49 crore from the Bihar State Educational Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited.
The project involves developing hybrid Smart Classrooms and ICT Labs in colleges and universities across Bihar under the PM-USHA Scheme.
Additional orders include a Rs 50.62 crore project from the Bihar Education Project Council (BEPC) for vocational education under Samagra Shiksha.
